propositions: Eight Jira modules currently at package root must be relocated into adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035

The three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require loader updates to resolve from the new subdirectory via relative subpaths without breaking other root module loads

All surviving references to moved modules across dotted imports and sibling-path loader calls must be repointed atomically, including ~18 test files using importlib.util.spec_from_file_location and ~18 files with direct dotted imports
The relocation must eliminate all re-export shims and leave zero references to old root paths in src/ and tests/ (excluding path-agnostic patch.object sites)
Full test suite must pass after the move, with loader tests confirming adf/outbound_fields/comment_limits resolve at new location and non-moved consumers like inbound_fields.py continue working
